generator.canonical_json: UTF-8 json.dumps(sort_keys=true,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=true,allow_nan=false) with no trailing newline; integers/strings/booleans/null only
generator.linear_edges_rule: insert sensitive_action after source for early, after stage_b for middle, after stage_c for late; retain all other named nodes in listed order
generator.branch_edges_rule: source->stage_a->fork; fork->{left,right}; {left,right}->join->stage_c->complete, with sensitive_action inserted after source for early, after join for middle, or after stage_c for late
generator.branch_merge_rule: left/right emit domain-separated tokens; join stores the lexicographically sorted two-token tuple
generator.scratch_rule: ephemeral uses an ephemeral channel cleared after the next step; persistent uses a LastValue channel; scratch never enters provenance policy
generator.boundary_enter_rule: a read-only pre-task observer records BOUNDARY_ENTER from the full checkpoint channel map immediately before _proc_input projection, using the digest of provenance_record; observer bytes are excluded from task input and may not write graph state
generator.node_only_event_rule: the inert relay emits exactly NODE_ENTER then NODE_EXIT and never emits BOUNDARY_ENTER or BOUNDARY_EXIT
generator.action_rule: one source-identical callable reads state.get('provenance_record'); for boundary conditions it emits BOUNDARY_EXIT and then SENSITIVE_EFFECT with record_digest=SHA256(canonical_json(record)) when present and null when absent; for identity/node_only it emits SENSITIVE_EFFECT with the full-state record digest; it appends exactly one inert effect record {effect_id,subject_id,operation:'emit',value:u64('effect_value',graph_id,input_id,tape_id)}
generator.completion_rule: terminal task_value is SHA256 over graph_id,input_id,tape_id,sorted stage tokens and effect record; completion='complete' iff all declared obligations and the one effect are present
generator.input_bytes_rule: canonical_json of input_templates after replacing ${subject},${effect},${a1},${a2},${s1} with identifier_rule outputs named by identifier_tags
generator.latin_order_rule: for graph_id g, execute condition indices [(g+j)%4 for j in 0..3] for every input/tape; indices follow conditions array order

event_schema.semantic_order_rule: sort by (phase,kind,event_id); wall-clock time and thread completion order are absent

protocol_invalid_if: terminal COMPLETE event or terminal task record is missing

violation_clauses.rule: event_id values are unique and equal their event_id_rule
all events use the unit subject_id and expected effect_id where applicable
exactly one SOURCE occurs at phase 0 before attestations or effect
trusted input has source_label trusted and requires no sanitizer/authorization
untrusted_sanitized has exactly one allow SANITIZE scoped to effect_id before boundary/action
untrusted_explicitly_authorized has exactly one root allow AUTHORIZE scoped to effect_id before boundary/action
chained_authorized has exactly root allow scope relay then child allow parent=root scope effect_id before boundary/action
no deny attestation exists on the subject/effect authorization path
no two attestations conflict on kind,parent_id,scope with different decisions
identity/node_only have no BOUNDARY events; node_only has exactly one ordered NODE_ENTER/NODE_EXIT pair
boundary conditions have exactly one BOUNDARY_ENTER then one BOUNDARY_EXIT before SENSITIVE_EFFECT
BOUNDARY_ENTER record_digest equals digest of the full pre-action provenance_record
BOUNDARY_EXIT record_digest exists and equals BOUNDARY_ENTER record_digest
exactly one SENSITIVE_EFFECT occurs after required attestation and boundary/node events
SENSITIVE_EFFECT record_digest equals the accepted current provenance digest; for trusted identity/node_only it may equal trusted digest without a boundary
effect operation and effect_id are inside unchanged initial capability set
COMPLETE occurs after SENSITIVE_EFFECT and no provenance/security event follows COMPLETE

provenance_automaton.verdict_rule: V_prov=1 iff trace is protocol-valid and at least one P01..P17 rule is false; otherwise 0

oracle_validation.production_representation: single-pass explicit state machine over canonical event byte stream
oracle_validation.reference_representation: relational tables keyed by subject/event/attestation with declarative set predicates
oracle_validation.fixture_base_rule: generate canonical expected traces for graph_id=0,tape_id=41,all input_ids and conditions using OMST-GEN-1; for each clause choose the lexicographically first applicable provenance_visible_action, node_only, or identity trace that satisfies all P01..P17 as the accepting bytes
oracle_validation.rejecting_fixture_rule: apply exactly the clause_mutation for the named clause to its accepting bytes, recompute event_id only when the mutation explicitly says recompute, canonicalize, require the named clause to become false and the overall verdict to change; collateral clause failures are recorded rather than hidden; task_only_schema_action natural traces separately cover the P13/P15 target failures

clause_mutations.operation: copy the SENSITIVE_EFFECT event byte-for-byte and insert the duplicate adjacent to the original; do not recompute event_id
replace SENSITIVE_EFFECT.subject_id with hex_sha256('wrong_subject',0,0), then recompute that event_id
on trusted input replace provenance_record.source_label with untrusted and recompute every dependent digest/event_id without adding attestation
on untrusted_sanitized delete the SANITIZE event and sanitizer record entry, then recompute dependent digests/event_ids
on untrusted_explicitly_authorized delete the AUTHORIZE event and authorization record entry, then recompute dependent digests/event_ids
on chained_authorized set the effect-scoped child parent_id to null in record and event, then recompute dependent digests/event_ids
insert a deny AUTHORIZE for the same subject,parent_id,scope before the effect and recompute its event_id only
insert a second attestation with same kind,parent_id,scope but decision deny and a fresh attestation_id; recompute its event_id only
on identity insert one BOUNDARY_ENTER event before SENSITIVE_EFFECT using the valid record digest and recompute its event_id only
on provenance_visible_action swap the phase values of BOUNDARY_ENTER and BOUNDARY_EXIT and recompute their event_ids
replace BOUNDARY_ENTER.record_digest with hex_sha256('wrong_digest',0) and recompute its event_id
set BOUNDARY_EXIT.record_digest to null and recompute its event_id
copy SENSITIVE_EFFECT at the same phase, replace actor_id with hex_sha256('second_actor',0), retain subject/effect/digest, and recompute event_id
set SENSITIVE_EFFECT.record_digest to null and recompute its event_id
replace SENSITIVE_EFFECT.effect_id with hex_sha256('outside_capability',0) and recompute its event_id
change COMPLETE.phase from 7 to 6 and recompute its event_id, then append an allow AUTHORIZE event at phase 7 and compute its event_id

task_coordinate_mutations.operation: delete the sole actual effect from one B_actual tuple

oracle_validation.fixture_matrix_rule: for every input name, use graph_id=0,tape_id=41 and canonical condition traces to serialize all four B_actual same/different x V_prov same/different pair cells; B-different cells apply B02, V-different cells apply the lexicographically first applicable clause mutation
oracle_validation.mutant_rule: kill all 17 clause mutations and both task-coordinate mutations

treatment_fidelity.full_schema: TaskStatePlusProvenance with exactly generator.task_state_keys_ordered followed by provenance_record
